acceptance.given: The Package A reference package and published validator CLI are available, and the A23 migration test invokes the repository-owned command through a literal subprocess argv.

oracle.expected: The test observes the published CLI process validating the reference package, parses its fresh structured result, and confirms no test-local lookalike CLI was executed.
forbidden: A test-local lookalike CLI is used instead of the published CLI.
The check relies only on an exit code, file existence, or assistant-reported status without observing the published CLI invocation.
oracle.observable: The A23 test records the subprocess executable/argv and validates the resulting structured output from the repository-owned CLI.

acceptance.then: The published CLI invocation and lookalike exclusion are established by the test's observable subprocess boundary and structured-result checks.
acceptance.when: The A23 migration test executes the Package A reference-package validation through the CLI.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_migration.py::test_a23 must fail when it invokes a test-local lookalike command or does not bind to scripts/sc/validate_skill_quality.py.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add the published validator CLI entry and an A23 integration check that exercises it with the reference package and rejects test-local command substitution.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Remove the new CLI entry and A23 test together; no persisted state or schema migration is introduced.

slice_hint.state_transition: Reference-package validation moves from an unbound or lookalike invocation to an observed call through the repository-published CLI.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The A23 pytest selector passes only when the published CLI executable is invoked with the reference package and the structured result proves the expected validation path.
